title: Clinical Outcomes Following One-Stage Cartilage Regenerative Procedures After Acute Patellar Dislocations Associated with Cartilage Flake Lesions
summary:
This project constitutes a retrospective data analysis of patients who underwent either a minced cartilage implantation or cartilage refixation in the retropatellar region due to cartilage damage caused by a patellar dislocation between 2020 and 2024. The aim of the analysis is to evaluate treatment outcomes and to identify potential factors influencing therapeutic success.
In addition to epidemiological parameters (age at the time of surgery, sex), radiological findings (X-ray/MRI) and subjective treatment outcomes (presence of instability, recurrent patellar dislocation, KOOS score obtained by questionnaire) will be assessed. These data are routinely collected in the course of clinical care.
To determine whether recurrent dislocations have occurred since surgery and whether patients continue to experience a sense of instability, participants will be contacted by telephone. No additional clinical investigations are planned as part of this study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who underwent either minced cartilage implantation or flake refixation in the retropatellar region following patellar dislocation with a cartilage flake were included. For underage participants, informed consent for study participation will be obtained by telephone from a legal guardian
Exclusion criteria:
In the event of telephone contact, patients may decline to participate in the survey
